key_idea: A board is valid iff it has exactly nine knights and no knight has another knight on any of its eight knight-move squares.
sketch: Read the 5x5 grid, count the k cells, and for every knight test the eight L-shaped offsets with bounds checking. Print valid only if the count is exactly 9 and no attacking pair was found. Constant time. The usual pitfall is forgetting the exactly-nine condition (sample 3 has only 8 knights and is invalid).
